newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies rise limit on stops, low stocks.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies rise limit on stops, low stocks.

text.p: CME pork belly futures jumped up the daily limit of 3.000 cents per lb in July and August before running into profit taking, traders said.

Demand sparked by expectations of a possible out-movement indicated on CME's weekly out-of-town storage report Tuesday afternoon lifted futures into buy stops and prices shot up the limit, traders said.

Futures currently stand 2.675 to 1.900 cents per lb higher with July up 2.450 at 93.175 cents after posting a new contract high at limit up at 93.725 cents. August also advanced the limit to a new high of 91.825 cents.
